notes.title: Pets & Friends Update
notes.content:
Dear Clawler

We just released a new small update featuring:
- New character selection screen
- New playable character: Nanny Fran
- Updated pet mechanics, perks and items

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/d0a9db9a2da784d2d3bb04fb438a32ff1599ad73.png[/img]

Dungeon Clawler is today’s Daily Deal on Steam at 30% off 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356780/Dungeon_Clawler/
Additionally, we have some news!
We have just launched the 1.0 version of our game The Wandering Village.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1121640/The_Wandering_Village/

We added a special skin to celebrate the occasion 😀
Launch Dungeon Clawler, open the settings, press the ‘Redeem Code’ button at the bottom and enter 'TheWanderingVillage' to unlock the skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/fdf8f6ed35adbf9261d077c5c3039141fe91b0f1.png[/img]

Lastly, we have a new partnership to announce!
We teamed up with Blukulélé and are now the publisher of his awesome chess roguelike Gambonanza!

Gambonanza is a mind-bending roguelike where every move counts. Unlock over 100 innovative Gambits and harness powerful synergy with your chess pieces to transform your board into a festival of explosive combos and tactical twists!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3509230/Gambonanza/
You can try out the game via Steam Playtest for 4 days starting now, until July 21st.
Wishlist and Follow the game on Steam to unlock a Gambonanza-themed Bunalot skin 😀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/23388ab7e6d98a8a0c2c4e5bcfac16fb6cfb847b.png[/img]
Thanks for your support and see you soon,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Frosty Fortune Update

[p]Dear Clawlers

Thank you all for your patience and for all the feedback and bug reports for the Testing Branch version 😀
Finally, we have a new Dungeon Clawler Update for you 🔥[/p][p]

- 3 new playable characters: Baroness von Frost, Astrobun, new secret character
- New claw type: Anti-Gravity Cannon
- New Fortune Teller Room, that lets you influence the drop chances for certain item types.
- New Gambling Rooms
- A new frost-themed boss
- Many new items, perks and enemies
- New game-over and winning the game cutscenes
- New unlockable character skins
- Lots of balancing improvements and bug fixes
- A new music track and more

For the complete list, make sure to check out the patch notes:[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2356780/view/500575275933764262"][/dynamiclink]

We hope you enjoy this new update and are looking forward to your feedback 😀  

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/b31a6c55bbf6b07fe26206ce1959463f21eb5a06.png"][/img]

In other news:
- The game is -20% on Steam until June 11th!

[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356780/Dungeon_Clawler/"][/dynamiclink]- We currently have some giveaways running in our [url="https://discord.gg/jCWkZ37tR5"][u]Discord[/u][/url] if you’d like to join.[/p][p]

Thanks for checking in and see you soon,

Stray Fawn Studio[/p]

notes.title: Debt Level Update
notes.content:
Dear Clawlers

A big, [b]new content update[/b] just dropped on both Steam and mobile 💣
We completely reworked the game’s difficulty levels and have added a [b]‘Debt Level’ system [/b]which allows you to test your skills against increasingly tricky difficulty modifiers 🔥
Please note that due to this new system, old runs will no longer be compatible with this patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/5430dbb84b11c461d4d4babbbbc58850bd62ab57.jpg[/img]

This update also includes a [b]new character[/b]!
Many years ago Toxicarl was training to be an alchemist under Great Mage Augmentus. During his training, he experimented with potent toxins and accidentally inhaled some! In the following poison-fueled rampage, he destroyed his teacher's scholarly tomes, so the Great Mage had no choice but to banish him. Now Toxicarl roams the dungeon with his poison flask…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/9d903aced9fe53537fb7bd33417cbef83af75529.jpg[/img]

As well as new items and perks and skins!
Check out the full patch notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2356780/view/588387954308677663

We hope you enjoy the new update and would love to hear your feedback 😀
We're especially keen to know if anybody here is able to beat the game on Debt Level 20!
If you’d like to get a glimpse on what we’re working on next, chat with the devs and grab an exclusive new Bunalot skin, please come join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/jCWkZ37tR5


In other news:
It’s [b]Steam Spring Sale and Dungeon Clawler is 20%[/b] off

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356780/Dungeon_Clawler/

Alongside many other games that are developed or published by our team.
Check out the [b]Stray Fawn Spring Sale[/b] here:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/strayfawn/sale/strayfawnspringsale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/63dce7e62b402aa6a8806ed91596cc10d3ce4c6b.png[/img][/url]


Thanks for checking in and see you soon,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Patchnotes Dungeon Clawler Early Access 0.7.3
notes.content:
This patch will break old saves, because of the new debt level system.

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a Debt Level System, which adds stacking difficulty modifiers for each level. Winning a run on one debt level unlocks the next. There are 20 levels in total.
[*] If you have already won a run on nightmare you already start with debt level 10 already unlocked. 
[/list]
[h3]New Character[/h3]
[list]
[*] Toxicarl
[/list]
[h3]New Perks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dirty Money
[*] Suspicious Green Rod
[*] Noxious Cape
[/list]
[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chocolate Bathbomb
[*] Holy Water
[*] Leech
[*] Garden Shears
[*] Serrated Blade
[*] Toxic Bulwark
[*] Smog Bomb
[*] Toxicarl's Flask (for Toxicarl only)
[/list]
[h3]New Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Coink
[*] Coin Grabbler
[*] Monkfish
[/list]
[h3]Improvements / Reworks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lucky Paws can now be used independent of the difficulty mode
[*] Removed the different difficulty modes and replaced them with the debt level system
[*] Run Endscreen now shows the detailed info of the lucky paw you received
[*] Changed Skip and Change-Tab gamepad layout on the reward screen to make more sense
[*] Added small particle effects when an item gets removed (Recycle-Bin or Garbage Greg's perk) to make it more clear what happens
[*] Renamed Reward room to Granny's room
[*] Added two new unlockable character skins
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Brass Knuckle and Hand Mirror now have a cooldown of 2 turns before they can be dropped into the machine again
[*] Reduced healing of Count Clawcula's lucky paw from 10% to 5%
[*] Golden Armor now only increases your health up to a maximum of 100, however it has no longer a stack limit
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Squalo stops adding Piggies when the box is filled with Spikes
[*] Barrakiddo now spawns more spikes on higher floors (up to 20 per turn)
[*] Fixed Mouse-Input buttons being overlapped by debuffs or damage numbers
[*] Swamp-Water should now correctly fill Waterpistols
[*] Meli Bomb now correctly deals 10 damage to the player instead of 20 when exploding
[/list]

notes.title: Holiday Update & Skin Challenge

Dear Clawlers
The first content update after the launch just dropped 🎉

This update features:
- Cuddline Floofington, a new character focused on interesting synergies with Fluff
- New items and perks
- a Special room which is only available during Christmas holidays
- Varies balancing improvements and bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/be93b026a31768422681121e7066d0fb909a802a.png[/img]

Also on our [url=https://discord.gg/jCWkZ37tR5]Discord[/url] we’re now running a special skin design challenge. Finalists can win a Dungeon Clawler full game key and the winning skin gets added to the game!

Cheers & Thanks,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Patchnotes Dungeon Clawler Early Access 0.6.1
notes.content:
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] New playable character: Cuddline Floofington
[*] Added special room which is only available during Christmas holidays
[/list]
[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] Teddy
[*] Glass Cleaner
[*] Eyepatch
[/list]
[h3]New Perks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cuddly
[*] Critical Strength
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*] All modified fluff items are now executed instantly when picked up instead of added into the tube
[*] Modified Fluff does not count as an Item anymore and therefore can no longer be dodged or reflected, but also do not trigger Perks that react to an attack.
[*] The damage of burning Fluff no longer scales with strength, as it's no longer a usable item, but an indirect attack.
[*] Tentacle-, Harpoon- and Magnet-Claw pickup buff can now be stacked and use up a stack each turn
[/list]
[h3]Improvements [/h3]
[list]
[*] Some new and improved Sound effects
[*] You can now move on the map by clicking with the mouse
[*] The title of items in the mouseover tooltip is now colored based on item rarity
[*] Added item detail display to shredder room
[/list]
[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Poisonous Attacks, Poisonous Weapons and Vampire Fangs are now only triggered if the attack was successful and not when avoided or mirrored.
[*] Permanent pets can no longer be replaced by temporary ones
[*] Fixed bug where temporary upgraded items did not update their values correctly (credit card, syringe, etc)
[*] Fluff eaten by piranhas is now removed for the duration of the fight and won't spawn again
[*] Damage modifiers now also affect poison that was spread using the contagious poison perk
[/list]

notes.title: Patchnotes Dungeon Clawler Early Access 0.5.2
notes.content:
Dear Clawlers,

We just released a small balancing and bugfixing patch, adressing some frustrating parts of the game based on your feedback! Thanks alot for all the feedback! 

And for those of you who can't get enough of the game, don't worry we are already hard at work on the next content patch which will come soon and will include Steam Achievements, a new character and some new Items and improvement :)

Here are the full Patchnotes:

[h2]Patchnotes Dungeon Clawler Early Access 0.5.2[/h2]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Code Redeem button to the Options Menu, used in the future to unlock stuff.
(Enter "SlimeSlime" to unlock a testing skin for sir bunalot ;) )
[*] Added a second battle music track 
[/list]
[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*]Enemy attack damage and health is a bit lower on normal difficulty to make it easier to newcomers.
[*]Inky now only fills the tank with Ink once
[*]Thief Perk no longer increases Squalos strength, only piggy banks and coins picked up from the machine will
[*]On Floor 12 a crafting room with all 3 stations is now guaranteed
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Reroll and other buttons now show a shortened price number
[*]Honeyballs are a bit less rigidly connected to other items, so that items can be compressed or torn away with enough force
[*]Honeyballs lose their stickyness in the exit chute to avoid blocking it
[*]Claws move a tiny bit further right before releasing the items
[*]The skip button displays shows skip and collect rewards in the Perk-o-mat room, so you don't have to be afraid to click it
[*]Default resolution on Steamdeck is now 1280x800
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some localization issues
[*]Plastic items should now also be moved back into the box if they are placed on the ledge in the top left. (looking at you, Piranhas)
[*]Fixed bug where the treasure chest reverted back to wood when opened
[*]Fixed bug where the water pistol reverted back to plastic when filled with liquid
[*]Fixed bug where wood oil could be applied to morning stars and helmets to have an unwanted effect that caused the armor to get multiplied alot
[*]Fixed small bug where claws moved a bit to the right when despawned
[*]Fixed bug where the drop-claw button got auto triggered when using mouse only mode
[*]Fixed bug where the game did not notice that the player died when killing the last enemy at the same time
[*]Fixed bug where Honeyballs having weird connections when items got removed or replaced (for example Squalos' piggy banks)
[*]Fixed gamepad navigation for news and promo panel and display the button needed to press in order to close them.
[/list]

notes.content:
Dear Clawlers

We finally have a launch date for the game!!!
Dungeon Clawler will be released on…
[h3]➡️➡️➡️ November 21 ⬅️⬅️⬅️[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/3ff0b319e1b10a9649df7bf5ab810d5136e37aea.jpg[/img]

We’ve added lots of new content to the game since the Next Fest in June.
- Difficulty modes (Normal, Hard, Very Hard and Nightmare)
- Unlockable lucky paws to equip your character with
- 5 new playable characters Squiddy, Garbage Greg, Anne Bunny and Hare L. Quinn
- New rooms (Alchemist to change materials, various mystery rooms)
- Reworked 20 floor map featuring multiple exists to choose from
- Full gamepad support
- New music and sound effects
- 13 new items
- 11 new perks 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/32fd4c087c504e4ae0c9e7b126c73faef681f067.gif[/img]

We are now starting our very last round of [url=https://discord.gg/jCWkZ37tR5]beta testing[/url], before the [b]demo + beta will go offline on November 18th![/b]

We’re super mega excited for the launch and can’t wait to pour more work into the game once it’s out there. A HUGE thanks to everybody who has been helping us with testing and translating, we couldn’t have done it without you. 

It would be awesome to see you guys over on our [url=https://discord.gg/jCWkZ37tR5]Discord[/url] so we can celebrate the launch together! And/or if you want to win a Steam key for the game in our raffles ;)

And if you haven’t wishlisted the game yet, please do!!!

Cheers & Thanks,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Patchnotes Dungeon Clawler Demo 0.2.1
notes.content:
We just released a new update for the demo, here are the patchnotes:

No Soundeffects and no Gamepad support yet. Those will be added for the release.
Previous savefiles are unfortunately not compatible and you'll have to start a new run.
[h2]New playable Characters:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Felina
[*] Benny Beaver
[*] Dolly
[*] Count Clawcula
[*] Bernie
[/list]
[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
[list]
[*] Melimon (Endboss)
[*] Bootshroom
[*] Dynamic Duo
[*] Spookolotl
[/list]
[h2]New Rooms[/h2]
[list]
[*] Perk-o-mat
[/list]
[h2]New Items:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sickle
[*] Spiky Stressball
[*] Cactus
[*] Wood Oil
[*] Whetstone
[*] Recycling Bin
[*] Felinas Catbox
[*] Laserpointer
[/list]
[h2]New Perks:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Critical Healing
[*] Junk Jet
[*] Bargain
[*] Hard Hits
[*] Dodgy
[*] Minimalist
[*] Catnip
[*] Greedy
[*] Lucky
[*] 
[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where the game was waiting for Items to be spawned, if there was no physical space left
[*] Fixed bug where items left on the ledge counted towards the collected item count
[*] Fixed bug where you could place a negative roulette bet
[*] Fixed bug that holy shield did not reset your block
[*] Fixed wrong chances to lose in the roulette room
[*] Fixed bug that magnets have stronger attraction to items that are farther away
[*] Fixed bug where items behaved very unstable when underwater
[*] Fixed bug where resolution settings where not applied correctly
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved performance if playing with a large amount of items
[*] The perk reward room now has a different machine to get perks
[*] There is a new resting room filled with coins and healthpots
[*] Added Mouse support, so you can play without a keyboard
[*] The Dropchance of new items is now modified based on the items you select after a fight.
[*] Pachinko now has a reroll button
[/list]
[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] New icons to show if an item is stackable, upgradeable or ethereal (can only be collected once per fight)
[*] Added Backpack to Map, so you can check your deck and stats
[*] Deck and Stats can now be viewed when choosing a reward
[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Morningstar is now stronger, but rare
[*] Playing Pachinko is now cheaper
[*] Savings Account now only rewards a maximum of 100 coins
[*] Battle Axe now first removes block before dealing damage
[*] Sir Bunalot now starts each Turn with Block
[*] Lord Squidula has been demoted to a normal boss and now has a different tactic
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update, meet Scrappy!
notes.content:
Dear Clawlers

We just released an update for the Dungeon Clawler Demo on Steam!
The star of this update is undoubtedly our new character: Scrappy
Scrappy is very fond of magnets and all things metal, as you will soon find out for yourselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/5360c47f52209318461ac8d0d8387bb0959da7ae.png[/img]

Aside from implementing character and item unlocks, we also added new items, item upgrades, perks and enemies as well as lots of UI improvements, balancing and bug fixes (such as the infamous int overflow bug). Check out the full patch notes here:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2356780/view/4195741362075084861

We hope you enjoy this update and we would love to hear your feedback over on our [url=https://discord.gg/Sc6GPrMYST]Discord[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911792/db3d59bc779b9d7031dc664726ea6dabba18bb42.png[/img]

And if you haven’t already, please wishlist the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2356780/Dungeon_Clawler/


Cheers & Thank you very much,
Stray Fawn Studio

notes.title: Patchnotes Dungeon Clawler Demo 0.1.2
notes.content:
[h2]New playable Character[/h2]
- Scrappy

[h2]New Items[/h2]
- Paperclip
- Credit Card
- Hand of Midas
- Thermometer
- Plastic Shield
- Plastic Knife
- Syringe
- Metal Shield
- Magnet Claw 

[h2]New Perks[/h2]
- Magnetism

[h2]Features[/h2]
- Added an item that you unlock when reaching Floor 6 with Scrappy
- Added two new enemies
- Added upgrades for most of the items
- Pachinko can now reward upgraded items

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
- Fixed bug where numbers would become negative if too high
- Fixed bug where items got stuck inside walls
- Fixed bug where water still applying effects when being drained
- Fixed bug where debuffs / buffs with 0 stacks where applied
- Fixed tooltips appearing under endscreen
- Fixed bug where the game view zoomed in accidentally
- Fixed bug where ticking bomb exploded too early
- Fixed Fluffy and Hoarder Perk not working as intended
- Fixed Swamp perk, so that the water is still drained correctly every turn
- Made fluff physics less explosive when getting transformed into burning or poison fluff
- If the physics simulation gets too complicated, it will now slow down time instead of producing a slideshow (dont stack too many magnets, it will lag)
- Fixed bug where you could skip tiles by walking diagonally
- Fixed bug where the game was saved incorrectly and you had less health when loading the game
- Fixed bug where you got the same boss twice in a row
- Damage from spikes can no longer be reflected or dodged
- Healing Potions in reward rooms now correctly heal you

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
- Rebalanced values of all items and enemies, generally you get less block, more healing, but enemies deal a bit less damage. Please check out the new item overview inside the game to see all changes.
- Magnets no longer increase the damage of attracted items
- Removed Bonusclaw and Masterclaw Perks, claw upgrades will be handled differently in the future
- Waterbottle does no longer reset lava or poison water, instead it just fills the tank with the current liquid
- Balanced Coin Economy
- Perk satchels are a bit smaller and easier to grab

[h2]UI[/h2]
- Added new Section where you can see an overview over all items and perks
- Moved the How to Section to a separate screen
- Fixed various typos
- Coins are better visible while choosing a reward
- Applying Settings is now visually confirmed
- Renamed Recycler to Shredder to make its purpose clearer
- The game is now also translated to Japanese
- Added new gameover screen
- Rare items now look differently on the reward screen
